name: GitHub repository monitor
description: Watch a repository for @OpenHands mentions in issues and PR comments, start a conversation, and post the agent's reply back to GitHub.

github.message: Used to read issue and pull request comments and post replies.

exampleImplementation:
Trigger: cron, every minute (configurable)
Required secret: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN

1. Poll GitHub for new issue and PR comments since the last run.
2. Match comments containing the trigger phrase (case-insensitive, default: @OpenHands).
3. Post an acknowledgment comment with a link to the new OpenHands conversation.
4. Forward follow-up replies in the same thread to the running conversation.
5. Post the agent's final response back to GitHub when the conversation completes.

eventType.label: Respond to
eventType.help: Which GitHub comment event starts a conversation.

options.label: Comments on issues and pull requests

triggerPhrase.label: Trigger phrase
triggerPhrase.help: Only comments containing this phrase start a conversation. Matched case-insensitively. Quotes and backslashes are not allowed, because the phrase becomes part of the event filter expression.

repository.label: Repository
repository.help: The repository to watch for mentions.

baseRef.label: Base branch
baseRef.help: Branch checked out when the agent responds.

payload.name: Mention responder - {{form.repository}}
payload.prompt: A comment in {{form.repository}} mentions '{{form.triggerPhrase}}'. Read the surrounding issue or pull request context from the event payload, then post a helpful reply as a comment on the same thread.
